meta.title: Codex UI
meta.description: Codex-style sidebar, workspace tree, global search, and turn navigation.

en.about.dependenciesDescription: Install or update each companion separately, or install missing plugins and update old versions in one action. Check Codex UI, expert, skill, archive, IM, scheduled-task, BTW, Simplify, PUA, code review, pet, and marketplace plugins on their own.
en.about.description: Adds a Codex-style sidebar, workspace conversation management, search, and turn navigation to DSH.
en.about.downloadsSource: Cumulative npm downloads from package creation through yesterday. View package on npm.
en.about.feature.conversation: Keeps native messages, tool calls, composer, permissions, and model selection while refining the container visuals
en.about.feature.navigator: Navigate directly to each user prompt with the current conversation turn navigator
en.about.feature.search: Find conversations, settings pages, and quick actions from the top search panel
en.about.feature.sessions: Rename, pin, mark unread, archive, delete, or use context actions for conversations
en.about.feature.sidebar: Codex-style sidebar, global conversation search, and settings entry points
en.about.feature.workspace: Expand, collapse, reorder, and pin workspace folders while retaining native workspace behavior

en.sessionTitle.system:
Generate a title for a coding-assistant conversation.
Output exactly one line with two parts: Type｜Theme
Type must be one of: {types}
The theme must be a concrete subject and must not repeat the type. Do not write dates, emoji, quotes, prefixes, explanations, or Markdown.
Write the theme in the language of the user message.
en.sessionTitle.userFrame: Generate a conversation title from this user message. Return only one Type｜Theme line. Do not add a third part or repeat the theme.
